summary: Executed auth security validation across backend and UI for containment, password recovery/change, token invalidation, and responsive auth flows. Backend auth suite: 16 passed / 2 failed (auth cookie + CORS origin policy). UI flows passed for forgot/reset/settings, startup session revocation handling, and login/document/private-vault regression.

critical.issue: No application auth httpOnly session cookie is set on login; only infra cookie (__cf_bm) appears. Test: test_login_sets_httponly_cookie.

CORS origin handling is inconsistent for credentialed auth calls (backend .env has CORS_ORIGINS='*', OPTIONS response origin mismatches public app origin). Test: test_cors_credentials_do_not_use_wildcard_origin.

minor.issue: Resend rejects TEST_* @example.com recipients in this environment; endpoint correctly returns generic message and does not expose raw reset token. External sender/domain verification remains a deployment dependency.

action_items: Implement explicit application auth cookie strategy (httpOnly, Secure, SameSite, scoped domain/path) or adjust requirement/tests if Bearer-only is intentional.
Set explicit CORS_ORIGINS list for deployed frontend origins and keep allow_credentials=true without wildcard behavior.
Re-run iter21 auth suite after fixes: /app/backend/tests/test_password_recovery.py + /app/backend/tests/test_iter21_auth_hardening.py.
critical_code_review_comments: JWT secret is env-only (no hardcoded fallback) and token_version invalidation is correctly enforced in get_current_user().
Password reset records are hash-only (token_hash), single-use, and TTL indexes exist for reset/login rate-limit collections.
Large monolithic backend file remains (>3000 lines), increasing auth/security change risk and regression surface.
test_credentials: Used disposable TEST_* accounts only. Owner password/emergency owner reset token were not requested or used.
seed_data_creation: Created disposable TEST_iter21_* and TEST_ui_* users, plus seeded disposable password_reset_tokens for UI reset-route completion validation.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Key failures are reproducible via /app/backend/tests/test_iter21_auth_hardening.py (cookie + CORS tests). UI auth flows validated end-to-end, including reset route completion using a seeded disposable token. Do not use owner emergency token.
rca_of_the_issue: RCA-1 (auth cookie): login currently returns JWT in JSON body and does not set an app session cookie; observed Set-Cookie is Cloudflare __cf_bm only. RCA-2 (CORS): config allows credentials but origin handling is inconsistent due wildcard/default and environment-origin mismatch, causing policy non-compliance risk for credentialed auth flows. Resend blocker observed is external domain/sender/recipient policy, while endpoint behavior remains generic and non-leaky.
